description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Notify the First Meeting of the Dehiwala - Mt. Lavinia and 17 other Local Government Bodies in Western Central Province
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the schedule for the first meetings of Local Government Authorities in the Western Province for the purpose of selecting Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Deputy Chairmen. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the convening of meetings for newly elected local government bodies, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including election-related meetings and procedures.
